propositions: REBAR_LLM_MODEL env var is a single-scalar knob superseded by per-class model configuration and must be deprecated with a removal window rather than kept as a permanent alias
The deprecation warning must be emitted at every env-read site (both config.py:469 and model_classes.py) to catch all code paths, not just one
REBAR_LLM_MODEL maps to all three model classes (frontier, gate, reviewer) as a fallback default when no explicit per-class configuration exists
Deprecation registration goes through _deprecations.REGISTRY via _scheduled() with remove_in=_MAJOR, not _permanent(), because this is a supersession by a different interface, not a rename

Documentation must be updated across six prose files (README.md, docs/llm-framework.md, docs/config.md, docs/plan-review-gate.md, docs/workflow-authoring-v2.md, docs/env-vars.md) to present class configuration as the current interface
